items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I was Georgie Boyd drummer. That's recently after I left my poetry and came here. I was a drummer and there was Georgie Boyd on clarinet, Edward Johnson on alto, and an old man... on the banjo. And Coochie Martin on the piano.

ctx.x: nightclubs then. We had cabaret this time. There were a lot of little places along there, even

during the depression they had a lot of them. Yeah. We had nothing but cabaret. Well I used to play at the French Market Cabaret out on Decatur Street, right out of the country. And I played the lead of the band then was Georgie Boyd. Oh yeah. Punch Talks is a lot about him. He played with punch quite a bit. Yeah. Well I was his drummer. I was Georgie Boyd drummer. That's recently after I left my poetry and came here. I was a drummer and there was Georgie Boyd on clarinet, Edward Johnson on alto, and an old man,…

Yeah. I heard it. He played guitar too. Right. And piano. That was the little band. Who was the trumpet or was there a trumpet? Did you name it? We didn't have a trumpet. Didn't have a trumpet. No. Just had two horns clanned up and alto. Yeah. Well in regard to your drums, what kind of a drum set did you get when you first got one and what? Well the first... About the drum style being different then than now or how did it look like?
